name: Animal Half
source:
One day main character's peaceful life gets interrupted by arrival of Maya and Kira girls with cat ears. They are maids dispatched by protagonist's uncle to live together for a week. The clumsy, but sweet cohabitation begins.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-march-2005-parfait-chocolat.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
某天，主人公平静的生活被两名猫耳少女まや与きら打破。她们是叔父派来的女仆，将与主人公共同生活一周。一段笨拙却甜蜜的同居生活就此开始。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-march-2005-parfait-chocolat.html]vndbreview[/url]]
